import os
from functools import lru_cache
from typing import Optional

from google.cloud import secretmanager


def get_project_id() -> str:
    project_id = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT") or os.environ.get("GCP_PROJECT") or os.environ.get("GCLOUD_PROJECT")
    if not project_id:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing Google Cloud project id; set GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
    return project_id


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def get_secret_client() -> secretmanager.SecretManagerServiceClient:
    return secretmanager.SecretManagerServiceClient()


def resolve_version_name(project_id: str, secret_id: str, version: str) -> str:
    return f"projects/{project_id}/secrets/{secret_id}/versions/{version}"


def normalize_secret_name(secret_name: str) -> str:
    return secret_name.strip().replace("//", "/")

import json
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SecretValueResult:
    provider: str
    secret_id: str
    version: str
    value: str
    stage: Optional[str] = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DBSecret:
    connection_string: str
    provider: str = "google-cloud-secret-manager"

    @classmethod
    def from_secret_value(cls, secret: SecretValueResult) -> "DBSecret":
        return cls(connection_string=secret.value, provider=secret.provider)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ParsedJsonSecret:
    provider: str
    secret_id: str
    version: str
    data: Dict[str, Any]

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, secret: SecretValueResult, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "ParsedJsonSecret":
        return cls(provider=secret.provider, secret_id=secret.secret_id, version=secret.version, data=data)

import os
import re
from typing import Optional

from google.cloud import secretmanager

from security_models import LabelSafetyResult


_PROVIDER = "google-cloud-secret-manager"
_UNSAFE_PATTERN = re.compile(r"(password|token|api[-_ ]?key|secret|drop\s+table|rm\s+-rf)", re.IGNORECASE)


def secret_label_safety(label: str, notes: Optional[str] = None) -> LabelSafetyResult:
    text = f"{label} {notes or ''}".strip()
    is_safe = _UNSAFE_PATTERN.search(text) is None
    reason = "clean" if is_safe else "unsafe pattern detected"
    return LabelSafetyResult(provider=_PROVIDER, label=label, is_safe=is_safe, reason=reason)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    label = os.environ.get("SECRET_LABEL", "default-label")
    notes = os.environ.get("SECRET_NOTES")
    result = secret_label_safety(label, notes)
    print(result.reason)

import os
from typing import List

from openai import OpenAI

from security_models import AuditEmbeddingResult


_PROVIDER = "openai"
_MODEL = "text-embedding-3-small"


def secret_audit_embedding(notes: str) -> AuditEmbeddingResult:
    client = OpenAI()
    response = client.embeddings.create(model=_MODEL, input=notes)
    vector: List[float] = list(response.data[0].embedding)
    return AuditEmbeddingResult(provider=_PROVIDER, text=notes, vector=vector)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    notes = os.environ.get("AUDIT_NOTES", "Secret rotation completed without incident.")
    embedding = secret_audit_embedding(notes)
    print(len(embedding.vector))

import os

from openai import OpenAI

from security_models import TranslatedRunbook


_PROVIDER = "openai"
_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"


def runbook_translate(source_text: str, target_language: str) -> TranslatedRunbook:
    client = OpenAI()
    response = client.responses.create(
        model=_MODEL,
        input=f"Translate the following secret-rotation runbook into {target_language}:\n{source_text}",
    )
    translated = response.output_text
    return TranslatedRunbook(provider=_PROVIDER, source_text=source_text, target_language=target_language, translated_text=translated)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    source_text = os.environ.get("RUNBOOK_TEXT", "Rotate the secret and verify dependent services.")
    target_language = os.environ.get("TARGET_LANGUAGE", "Spanish")
    result = runbook_translate(source_text, target_language)
    print(result.translated_text)
